name: Smart Studio Algebra
tagline: Math, but make it a studio. Pick your canvas. 🎨
howToPlay: Read the problem, then solve it one line at a time. Tap Check! after every line and we'll tell you exactly where it went wrong. Stuck? Grab a hint or tap Show me how.
levelPickerSubtitle: Level 1 = a quick sketch. Level 5 = the masterpiece. 🖌️
footerNote: ✨ No sign-up, no passwords — just you, the numbers, and a finished piece.

levels.name: The Missing Tubes
levels.cheer: The art room had a stack of paint tubes. The teacher ordered 47 more, and now there are 132 on the shelf. 🎨
levels.question: How many tubes were there to begin with?
hints: The x is stuck with a “+ 47”. Get rid of it.
Subtract 47 from BOTH sides to keep it balanced.

walkthrough.title: Find the goal
walkthrough.body: We want x on its own. Right now it has “+ 47” attached.

levels.name: Brush Sets
levels.cheer: You bought 6 identical brush sets for the studio. Altogether that's 84 brushes. 🖌️
levels.question: How many brushes are in one set?
hints: 6x means 6 times x. To undo times, you divide.

levels.name: Framing Day
levels.tagline: Two moves, in the right order.
levels.cheer: Each frame costs the same. You bought 3 frames and a $12 roll of tape, and spent $45 in total. 🖼️
levels.question: How much was one frame?
hints: Deal with the lonely number first. That + 12 goes.

walkthrough.title: Split it up
walkthrough.body: x is multiplied by 3, so divide BOTH sides by 3.

levels.name: Decimal Paints
levels.cheer: You had some money saved. You found $2.75 in your smock pocket, and now you have $9.50 for supplies. 💰
levels.question: How much had you saved?
hints: Same idea as before — undo the addition.

walkthrough.title: Same move, new numbers
walkthrough.body: A decimal changes nothing about the method.

walkthrough.title: Subtract carefully
walkthrough.body: 9.50 − 2.75 = 6.75. Keep the decimal points lined up.

levels.name: The Gallery Wall
levels.cheer: You're hanging art in 2 identical rows. Each row has your paintings plus the 5 borrowed ones. All together there are 34 pieces on the wall. 🖼️
levels.question: How many of your paintings are in each row?
hints: You can divide both sides by 2 first, or multiply out the bracket. Either works.

walkthrough.title: Undo the outside first
walkthrough.body: The whole bracket is multiplied by 2, so divide BOTH sides by 2. 34 ÷ 2 = 17.
